blue.limitations: The assessment of cardiomegaly based solely on a single frontal and lateral chest radiograph can be limited. Factors such as patient positioning, inspiration level, and body habitus can influence the apparent size of the heart. A more definitive assessment would typically involve echocardiography or other advanced imaging modalities.
